description.p: Ferramari is a video wallpaper for Linux, written in Rust. 🦀

Play local videos, streaming URLs or web pages as your desktop wallpaper, one source per monitor. It can pause or mute itself when a window is maximized, apply a blurred video frame as the GNOME static wallpaper, and restore your original background on exit.

ul.li: New --doctor report: session/backend, desktop, X11 screens, media tools, VA-API probe, render nodes, idle and lock services.
Desktop integration summary in Settings; native Wayland is explicitly reported as unsupported.
Logind Lock/Unlock signals as a fallback for non-GNOME sessions, aggregated with the screensaver lock so one source cannot unlock early.
Event-driven X11 window watcher; idle desktops no longer wake the app every 300 ms.
Performance page with live CPU, RSS, thread, process and (where available) GPU metrics.
Benchmark harness for startup, CPU, memory, processes, GPU and mpv recovery.
Hardware decoding setting: Auto, VA-API or Off.
WebKit security settings, denied permissions, no pop-ups, and an optional network switch for web wallpapers.
Fix a deadlock in mpv shutdown after a crash; surface loadfile failures.
Clean abandoned thumbnail/static partial files on start.
Configurable Eco idle delay (1–1440 minutes) in Settings.
Balanced lowers the mpv frame rate to 30 fps while idle; Eco pauses.
Per-monitor Eco state is shown on Home cards and exposed as the D-Bus monitor_states property.
Monitor hotplug events are coalesced into one rebuild.
mpv loadfile errors are reported to the user instead of only being logged.
Home no longer rescans the video folder on every volume-slider tick.
Per-monitor Active/Idle/Occluded/Suspended policy; a fullscreen window on one monitor no longer pauses the others.
Quality, Balanced and Eco profiles, with idle pause in Eco.
mpv IPC moved to a dedicated worker; the GTK thread no longer waits for the socket or for IPC replies.
Screen lock, suspend and end-session watchers no longer block startup on D-Bus.
Config hotplug no longer discards pending volume/blur edits; one corrupt field no longer resets the whole config.
X11 samples now keep the last known state on a transient error, and HiDPI monitor scaling is accounted for.
Local file:// web wallpapers are accepted; hidden web wallpapers are muted.

Thumbnails generate 2–4× faster with a bounded worker pool

Power profiles, battery pause and suspend/resume handling

Flatpak manifest, CI, release automation and testing matrix

WebKit load-error reporting and one automatic retry
